messages:
Aisha: Leaving a short follow-up thread from today's all-hands for any crisp questions on mission, positioning, or competitors. Keep Qs 1-2 lines.
Ravi: For customer pitches, should we lead with performance or the operational guarantees?
Aisha: Start with the customer outcome (fast, predictable responses at scale). Then layer operational guarantees (rollouts, SLAs) when talking to platform owners.
Nora: Quick tech line we can use publicly?
Marco: "Optimized runtime + smart routing reduces p95 under real load." Avoid precise numbers for hosted unless context is given.
Dana: Competitor playbooks: some focus on model breadth, others on price. How do we counter both?
Aisha: For breadth, emphasize Redwood-verified variants and curated catalog for production. For price, show real TCO after batching/caching.
Ravi: Any assets coming for sales?
Dana: Yes  a one-pager and two 1-slide hooks (dev & infra) by Friday.
ops-bot: docs.redwood.ai/sales/one-pager (shared) :link:
Aisha: That's it  will close in 24h unless more Qs. Thanks!
